symptom: CATALOG.GRAPH_CYCLES returns 0 rows on a project whose CATALOG.GRAPH_MODULE_COUPLING lists mutual Source/Target module pairs, so a user reads 'no circular dependencies' from a table that was never computed (mendixlabs/mxcli#1060)
cause: graph_cycles_data is written only by the graph-analysis pass (REFRESH CATALOG COMMUNITIES), while graph_module_coupling is a plain SQL view over refs that any full-mode catalog answers. GRAPH_CYCLES and its four siblings appeared in neither fullOnlyTables nor sourceOnlyTables, so no warning fired; and the recorded build mode is only fast/full/source, so a communities-augmented cache is indistinguishable from a plain full one — which also let a later `refresh catalog full` drop the graph tables silently
insight: **An empty analytic table is only an answer once something distinguishes 'computed and empty' from 'never computed'.** The mode ladder could not carry that bit: fast/full/source is a LEVEL, and the graph pass is orthogonal to it (it augments any level), so folding it in makes 'source' and 'full+graph' incomparable — it has to be a flag, not a rank. Guard it by MEASUREMENT, not a second hand-written list: run the pass on a synthetic refs graph and diff which tables went from empty to non-empty, then compare that set to the classification map. Shape the fixture so every table fills — two clusters for the community split and the integration surface, one MUTUAL pair for cycles — or the guard silently skips the very table the bug was about
fix: Record MetaGraphAnalysis/MetaGraphResolution when the pass runs; classify the six tables in communitiesOnlyTables and warn 'requires refresh catalog communities (not run for this catalog)'; report it in SHOW CATALOG STATUS; re-run the pass when a full rebuild replaces a cache that had it
